title: Streamline chart legends with windowed DOM and ARIA chunked summaries
creator: Amaya Patel
description: Reduce legend and tooltip DOM cost for high-cardinality time-series while preserving accessible summaries for screen readers. Deliver a legend component that virtualizes long series lists, surfaces progressive ARIA snapshots (chunked summaries) to avoid verbose live updates, and ties into color/token semantics from the design system.
acceptance_criteria: Legend renders 1000-series list with <150 DOM nodes for visible window + stable offscreen placeholders
Screen reader receives concise summary per visible window (max 3 lines) via aria-live updates limited to user-initiated changes
Keyboard navigation remains deterministic: tab into legend focuses first visible item, arrow keys move within virtualized window
Fallback for accessibility-only browsers: non-virtualized linear DOM available when virtualization feature-flag disabled
Performance budget: initial legend mount <60ms on mid-tier laptop (measured in perf harness), incremental update <20ms for batch changes
Design tokens (color, spacing, type) used from tokens v3 and documented in the component spec
Unit + visual regression tests included, and an automated accessibility smoke test (axe) passes on the component demo page
design_notes: Investigate 'windowing' rather than full virtualization — keep small fixed number of DOM nodes and swap content to maintain consistent focus targets

Introduce 'aria-chunk' concept: break long series lists into numbered chunks (e.g., 'items 1–20 of 800'). Each chunk has a short aria-label summary generated from display name + last-value + sparklinesummary
Avoid continuous aria-live flood: only announce when a user opens/expands a legend section or explicitly toggles a series. No announcements for background telemetry updates
Progressive disclosure UI: collapsed condensed view that shows primary series and a 'Show more' affordance; expanded view uses windowing
Token mapping: expose a small utility mapping story in Figma for palette token -> chart role (primary, secondary, baseline, anomaly). Recommend high-contrast token variants for dark/light modes
Tooltip behavior: prefer contextual hover preview for pointer users; for keyboard/VO users show a persistent details panel that reads succinctly and can be dismissed via escape
engineering_notes: Prototype using offscreen canvas for sparkline thumbnails to reduce SVG/DOM overhead; paint into <canvas> and reuse as CSS background-image for visible nodes
Implement stable keying for virtualized list: maintain node identity so focus does not jump when window shifts
Batch DOM mutations for series toggles (requestAnimationFrame + microtask bundling) to avoid layout thrash
Provide a feature-flag to disable virtualization for debugging and older assistive tech compatibility
Instrument metrics: legend_mount_ms, legend_update_ms, aria_announcements_per_minute, dom_node_count, reflow_count
Create a perf harness page that can synthesize N-series and run Lighthouse/measure() snapshots in CI
comments: 2026-03-01 - Amaya Patel: Created initial ticket after design spike; prioritized as P1 for Cycle 52. Goal is to reduce reflows and SR noise for large-series dashboards.
2026-03-03 - Lucas Meyer: Engineering spike WIP — trying offscreen canvas sparklines, initial render time dropped ~2x for 400 series on devbox. Need to validate SR chunking UX with VoiceOver.
2026-03-05 - Priya Rao (PM): Agree on progressive disclosure; ensure we expose an API for customers to set chunk-size and condensed default state.

2026-03-07 - Accessibility review (internal): Recommended limiting aria-live to polite and aggregate summaries; advised against announcing numeric-only updates every tick. Also flagged keyboard focus trap risk when window shifts.
2026-03-09 - Design review: Updated token mapping in Figma; added contrast-tested variants for anomaly roles. Decided to show small inline color legend (12px swatch) in condensed mode.
2026-03-11 - Lucas Meyer: Implemented keyboard stabilization by keeping a stable sentinel element at window edges. Added feature-flag 'legend.windowing' for rollout. Benchmarks attached in PR.

2026-03-12 - QA: Created test plan entries for axe checks, keyboard nav tests, and perf budget automation. Found an edge-case where screen reader reads stale chunk index after reordering series — tracked as follow-up sub-issue ENG-22144.

Follow-ups: add analytics event when users expand 'Show more' and when aria-chunk announcements are triggered (to monitor real-world noise). Consider per-customer default chunk size via API for Dedicated/Private customers.
notes_for_release: Feature behind 'legend.windowing' flag. Default OFF for current release; enable for 10% of traffic in runtime-1.20. Include migration notes for customers that rely on exhaustive DOM selectors of legend items.
testing_checklist: axe baseline must have zero violations on demo page
Keyboard: tab to legend, arrow navigation, expand/collapse works and focus remains visible
Performance: mount <60ms on CI medium instance, update <20ms for 50 toggles batched
Visual: color tokens render correct swatches in light/dark
